resolved.suspectedKeyName: 3-menthene (Zaitsev, more substituted; major product from neomenthyl chloride)
resolved.reasoning: The stem names menthyl chloride and says the Cl is equatorial in the stable chair; for menthyl chloride only the C6 H is anti-periplanar to an axial Cl, so E2 gives 2-menthene (index 4, the key). The drawn structure (qs 'CC1CC[C@@H](C(C)C)[C@@H](Cl)C1') has the Cl cis to the isopropyl: that is neomenthyl chloride (RDKit, checked against menthol (1R,2S,5R) with O replaced by Cl). In neomenthyl chloride the Cl is axial in the stable chair with anti-periplanar H on both neighbors, so E2 gives mainly the Zaitsev 3-menthene (index 0). The stem and key are right only for menthyl chloride; a student who reads the drawing gets index 0.
